mapper.select: select c1.C_Name as ecfContractorName, c2.C_Name as ecfSupervisorName, c3.C_Name as ecfApplyUnitName, c1.C_Abbreviation as ecfContractorAbbName, c2.C_Abbreviation as ecfSupervisorAbbName, c3.C_Abbreviation as ecfApplyUnitAbbName, con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Code as conCode, con.Con_Money_Total as conMoneyTotal, pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Id as pId, mn.* from Con_EC_Fee mn left join SYS_Company c1 on mn.Ecf_Contractor = c1.C_Id left join SYS_Company c2 on mn.Ecf_Supervisor = c2.C_Id left join SYS_Company c3 on mn.Ecf_Apply_Unit = c3.C_Id left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id = mn.Con_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_ID = mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id = pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id = pro.P_Competent_Department where mn.Ecf_Id = #{id} and mn.Ecf_Type = '02'

select (select sum(case when Ecf_Apply_Money_Type = 1 then Ecf_Apply_Money else -abs(Ecf_Apply_Money) end) from Con_EC_Fee where Ecf_Type = '02' and Con_Id = #{conId} and Ecf_State = 7) + (select sum(case when Ecf_Apply_Money_Type = 1 then Ecf_Apply_Money else -abs(Ecf_Apply_Money) end) from Con_EC_Fee mn left join Con_EC ce on ce.Ec_Id = mn.Ec_Id where Ecf_Type = '01' and ce.Con_Id = #{conId} and Ecf_State = 7)

select c1.C_Name as ecfContractorName, c2.C_Name as ecfSupervisorName, c3.C_Name as ecfApplyUnitName, c1.C_Abbreviation as ecfContractorAbbName, c2.C_Abbreviation as ecfSupervisorAbbName, c3.C_Abbreviation as ecfApplyUnitAbbName, con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Code as conCode, con.Con_Money_Total as conMoneyTotal, pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Id as pId, ce.Ec_Code as ecCode, ce.Ec_Apply_Money as ecApplyMoney, ce.Ec_Main_Cause as ecMainCause, ce.Ec_Part as ecPart, ce.Ec_Reason as ecReason, dco.Dco_Name as dcoName, dco.Dco_Code as dcoCode, dco.Dco_Project_Name as dcoProjectName, dco.Dco_Major as dcoMajor, (select cdb.Dcb_Estimate_Amt from Con_Dc_Budget cdb where cdb.Dco_Id = mn.Dco_Id and cdb.Dcb_State = 7 limit 1) as dcbEstimateAmt, mn.* from Con_EC_Fee mn left join SYS_Company c1 on mn.Ecf_Contractor = c1.C_Id left join SYS_Company c2 on mn.Ecf_Supervisor = c2.C_Id left join SYS_Company c3 on mn.Ecf_Apply_Unit = c3.C_Id left join Con_EC ce on ce.Ec_Id = mn.Ec_Id left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id = mn.Con_Id left join Con_Dco dco on dco.Dco_Id = mn.Dco_Id left join Pre_Project pro on con.Con_Project_Id = pro.P_ID left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id = pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id = pro.P_Competent_Department where mn.Ecf_Id = #{ecfId} and mn.Ecf_Type = '01'

select c1.C_Name as ecfContractorName, c2.C_Name as ecfSupervisorName, c3.C_Name as ecfApplyUnitName, c1.C_Abbreviation as ecfContractorAbbName, c2.C_Abbreviation as ecfSupervisorAbbName, c3.C_Abbreviation as ecfApplyUnitAbbName, con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Code as conCode, con.Con_Money_Total as conMoneyTotal, pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Id as pId, ce.Ec_Code as ecCode, ce.Ec_Apply_Money as ecApplyMoney, ce.Ec_Main_Cause as ecMainCause, ce.Ec_Part as ecPart, ce.Ec_Reason as ecReason, ce.Ec_Construction_Name as ecConstructionName, ce.ec_Apply_Money as ecApplyMoney, ce.ec_Change_Type as ecChangeType, dco.Dco_Name as dcoName, dco.Dco_Code as dcoCode, dco.Dco_Project_Name as dcoProjectName, dco.Dco_Major as dcoMajor, (select cdb.Dcb_Estimate_Amt from Con_Dc_Budget cdb where cdb.Dco_Id = mn.Dco_Id and cdb.Dcb_State = 7 limit 1) as dcbEstimateAmt, mn.* from Con_EC_Fee mn left join SYS_Company c1 on mn.Ecf_Contractor = c1.C_Id left join SYS_Company c2 on mn.Ecf_Supervisor = c2.C_Id left join SYS_Company c3 on mn.Ecf_Apply_Unit = c3.C_Id left join Con_EC ce on ce.Ec_Id = mn.Ec_Id left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id = mn.Con_Id left join Con_Dco dco on dco.Dco_Id = mn.Dco_Id left join Pre_Project pro on con.Con_Project_Id = pro.P_ID left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id = pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id = pro.P_Competent_Department where mn.Ecf_Id = #{ecfId} and mn.Ecf_Type = '03'

select c1.C_Name as ecfContractorName, c2.C_Name as ecfSupervisorName, c3.C_Name as ecfApplyUnitName, c1.C_Name_History as ecfContractorNameHistory, c2.C_Name_History as ecfSupervisorNameHistory, c1.C_Abbreviation as ecfContractorAbbName, c2.C_Abbreviation as ecfSupervisorAbbName, c3.C_Abbreviation as ecfApplyUnitAbbName, con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Code as conCode, con.Con_Money_Total as conMoneyTotal, ce.Ec_Code as ecCode, dco.Dco_Name as dcoName, dco.Dco_Code as dcoCode, dco.Dco_Project_Name as dcoProjectName, dco.Dco_Major as dcoMajor, dco.Dco_Sub_Code as dcoSubCode,
ject.p_name as pName,
con.Con_Project_Id as pId,
(select cdb.Dcb_Estimate_Amt from Con_Dc_Budget cdb where cdb.Dco_Id = mn.Dco_Id and cdb.Dcb_State = 7 limit 1) as dcbEstimateAmt, mn.* from Con_EC_Fee mn left join SYS_Company c1 on mn.Ecf_Contractor=c1.C_Id left join SYS_Company c2 on mn.Ecf_Supervisor=c2.C_Id left join SYS_Company c3 on mn.Ecf_Apply_Unit=c3.C_Id left join Con_EC ce on ce.Ec_Id=mn.Ec_Id left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id=mn.Con_Id left join Con_Dco dco on dco.Dco_Id=mn.Dco_Id
left join Pre_Project ject on ject.P_Id=con.Con_Project_Id
left join Pre_Project pro on con.Con_Project_Id=pro.P_ID
${params.authSql}
where 1=1
and mn.Ecf_Type='01'
order by mn.${params.sortFiled} ${params.sortType}
order by ${params.sortSideFiled} ${params.sortType}
order by mn.Ecf_Create_Time DESC

select distinct ${selectClause} from Con_EC_Fee mn left join SYS_Company c1 on mn.Ecf_Contractor=c1.C_Id left join SYS_Company c2 on mn.Ecf_Supervisor=c2.C_Id left join SYS_Company c3 on mn.Ecf_Apply_Unit=c3.C_Id left join Con_EC ce on ce.Ec_Id=mn.Ec_Id left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id=mn.Con_Id left join Pre_Project prect on prect.P_ID=mn.p_Id left join Con_Dco dco on dco.Dco_Id=mn.Dco_Id
${params.authSql}
where 1=1
and mn.Ecf_Type='03'

select sum(ce.Ec_Apply_Money) as ecApplyMoneySum, sum(case when mn.Ecf_Apply_Money_Type=1 then mn.Ecf_Apply_Money else -1*mn.Ecf_Apply_Money end) as ecfApplyMoneySum, sum(case when mn.Ecf_Duration_Type=1 then mn.Ecf_Duration else -1*mn.Ecf_Duration end) as ecfDurationSum from Con_EC_Fee mn left join SYS_Company c1 on mn.Ecf_Contractor=c1.C_Id left join SYS_Company c2 on mn.Ecf_Supervisor=c2.C_Id left join SYS_Company c3 on mn.Ecf_Apply_Unit=c3.C_Id left join Con_EC ce on ce.Ec_Id=mn.Ec_Id left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id=ce.Con_Id left join SYS_Company c4 on con.Con_Party_B_Id=c4.C_Id left join Pre_Project pro on con.Con_Project_Id=pro.P_ID
${params.authSql} and mn.Ecf_Type='01'
select sum(mn.Ecf_Preliminary_Amount) from Con_EC_Fee mn where Con_Id = #{conId} and mn.Ecf_State = 7 and mn.Ecf_Preliminary_Amount is not null

select mcce.uuid, mcce.project_id as projectId, mn.P_Name as projectName, mcce.change_name as changeName, mcce.change_code as changeCode, mcce.ec_change_reason_type as ecChangeReasonType, mcce.reason, mcce.content, mcce.remark, mcce.apply_amount as applyAmount, mcce.create_uid as createUid, mcce.create_uname as createUname, mcce.create_time as createTime, mcce.state, mcce.ec_change_type as ecChangeType, mcce.engineer_change_type as engineerChangeType from multi_contract_con_ec mcce left join Pre_Project mn on mn.P_Id = mcce.project_id ${authSql} and mcce.project_id = #{projectId} and mcce.state = 7 and not exists ( select 1 from Con_EC_Fee ecf where ecf.mcce_id = mcce.uuid and (ecf.Ecf_State is null or ecf.Ecf_State <> #{invalidState}) )
and exists ( select 1 from Con_EC ce where ce.multi_contract_con_ec_id = mcce.uuid and ce.Con_Id = #{conId} )
order by mcce.create_time desc

select mn.Svis_Id as svisId, mn.P_Id as pId, mn.Svis_Name as svisName, mn.Svis_Project_Name as svisProjectName, mn.Svis_Code as svisCode, mn.Svis_Contractor_Amt as svisContractorAmt, mn.Svis_Create_Uid as svisCreateUid, mn.Svis_Create_Uname as svisCreateUname, mn.Svis_Create_Time as svisCreateTime, mn.Svis_State as svisState, mn.Svis_Proposed_Id as svisProposedId, mn.Svis_Major as svisMajor, mn.Svis_Content_Summary as svisContentSummary from Con_Svis mn
${authSql} and mn.P_Id = #{projectId} and mn.Svis_State = 7 and not exists ( select 1 from Con_EC_Fee ecf where ecf.cs_id = mn.Svis_Id and (ecf.Ecf_State is null or ecf.Ecf_State <> #{invalidState}) )
and exists ( select 1 from Con_EC ce where ce.Con_Svis_Id = mn.Svis_Id and ce.Con_Id = #{conId} )
and mn.Te_Id = #{teId}
order by mn.Svis_Create_Time desc
